## aussie-static embedding model

Bundled files: `aussiefy/data/model/vectors.f16`, `aussiefy/data/model/vocab.txt`.

Reviewed metadata: `name` = `aussie-static`; `recipe.base.model` = `sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2`; `recipe.base.revision` = `1110a243fdf4706b3f48f1d95db1a4f5529b4d41`; `version` = `1.3.0`.

- [sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2](https://huggingface.co/sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2/tree/1110a243fdf4706b3f48f1d95db1a4f5529b4d41): Upstream contributors; no separate NOTICE file identified in the 2026-10-13 audit. [Apache-2.0](LICENSES/Apache-2.0.txt).
- [nreimers/MiniLM-L6-H384-uncased](https://huggingface.co/nreimers/MiniLM-L6-H384-uncased): Upstream contributors. [MIT](LICENSES/MIT.txt).
- [microsoft/MiniLM-L12-H384-uncased](https://huggingface.co/microsoft/MiniLM-L12-H384-uncased): Copyright (c) Microsoft Corporation. [MIT](LICENSES/MIT.txt).
- [Google BERT uncased WordPiece vocabulary, via all-MiniLM-L6-v2](https://github.com/google-research/bert): Copyright 2018 The Google AI Language Team Authors. [Apache-2.0](LICENSES/Apache-2.0.txt).

**Modifications** (Apache-2.0 section 4(b)):

The base model was fine-tuned on pairs from aussiefy's own slang dictionary, distilled with Model2Vec into 256-dimensional static vectors, tuned again on the same pairs and exported as float16 rows. The recipe is in training/recipe.yaml and the process in training/README.md.

In vocab.txt, the [unused*] tokens and [CLS], [SEP] and [MASK] were removed; dictionary slang words and contracted forms were added as whole tokens.

## NLTK/TextBlob averaged-perceptron English tagger

Bundled files: `aussiefy/pos.py`, `aussiefy/data/pos/tagger.json.gz`, `aussiefy/data/pos/README.md`.

Reviewed metadata: `name` = `averaged-perceptron-english`; `source_sha256` = `6025f530624335c67d6547d44757b357b4e79bae030a0383e9887a92c1718f0b`; `version` = `nltk-data-2026-10-12`.

- [textblob-aptagger](https://github.com/sloria/textblob-aptagger): Copyright 2013 Matthew Honnibal. [MIT](LICENSES/MIT.txt).
- [NLTK averaged-perceptron English tagger](https://www.nltk.org/_modules/nltk/tag/perceptron.html): NLTK modifications Copyright 2015 The NLTK Project. [MIT](LICENSES/MIT.txt).

**Modifications**:

Inference is re-implemented without NLTK. Three upstream JSON files are combined, nonzero weights rounded to three decimals, and gzipped with a fixed timestamp; scripts/build_pos.py verifies the pinned archive checksum.
